CustomField.description: Maximum number of child rows allowed for Repeater and Table sections. Passed as max to c-flow-form-repeat and c-flow-data-table, which enforce the ceiling and disable new/clone actions once reached. Leave blank for no maximum.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The most rows a user may add to this repeater or table. New and Clone actions are blocked once the limit is reached; leave blank for no maximum.
CustomField.label: Max
